level1.description: Use for actionable elements  to provide a subtle yet noticeable separation from the main content such as main CTA Buttons, Navigation Bars

level2.description: Use for elements that temporarily rise above others during interactions, signaling an active or dynamic state such as dragging an item or hover state of cards

level3.description: Use for floating elements that have a connection to the layout itself, usually an extension to a layout item.E.g. popover lists (Select, Dropdown, etc.), floating panels (Color picker, Date-time picker), Tooltips, FAB etc.

level4.description:
Use for floating elements that are not part of the layout, and fully detached from it.
E.g. Dialogs, Snack Bars, floating Notifications, Steps bar, etc.

level4-soft.description: Use for cards,widgets or tables as a way to provide additional hierarchy or emphasis and differentiate from other elements.
